thai: ผู้เข้าสอบ/ผู้สมัคร
definition: a person who is taking an exam, or who is applying for a job or position
examples: Each candidate must show an ID card before the test begins. | Three candidates have applied for the head teacher's job.
collocations: exam candidate | strong candidate | candidate for the job

thai: ความชำนาญ/ความสามารถทางภาษา
definition: a high level of skill or ability, especially in a language
examples: The school runs an English Proficiency Test every term. | She has a high level of proficiency in Chinese.
collocations: language proficiency | proficiency test | high level of proficiency

definition: a person who watches students during an exam to make sure that nobody cheats
examples: The invigilator told us to put our pens down. | Two invigilators walked slowly between the desks.
collocations: exam invigilator | ask the invigilator | invigilate an exam

thai: ผู้สนับสนุน/ให้การสนับสนุน
definition: a person or company that pays for an event or activity, often to advertise itself
examples: The test was sponsored by a technology company. | The library found a new sponsor for its reading club.
collocations: main sponsor | corporate sponsor | sponsored by

thai: เหตุฉุกเฉิน
definition: a sudden, dangerous situation that needs action at once
examples: In an emergency, leave by the nearest exit. | The hospital's emergency department was full.
collocations: emergency exit | in an emergency | state of emergency

definition: across from something, on the other side of a road, room or space; also completely different
examples: The library is opposite the music room. | The two teams sat on opposite sides of the hall.
collocations: opposite the station | on the opposite side | the opposite direction

thai: สิ่งกีดขวาง/ปิดกั้น
definition: a line of objects put across a road or doorway to stop people from getting past
examples: Students built a barricade of desks against the door. | The teacher barricaded the library doors with shelves.
collocations: build a barricade | behind the barricade | barricade the door

thai: การติดเชื้อ
definition: an illness caused by bacteria or a virus getting into the body
examples: Clean the cut carefully to stop infection. | A bite from an infected person spreads the infection.
collocations: risk of infection | serious infection | spread infection

thai: เสบียง/จัดหาให้
definition: an amount of food, water or other things that people need, kept ready to use
examples: We need to find supplies of water and food. | The canteen supplies lunch for eight hundred students.
collocations: water supply | in short supply | supply run

thai: ขาดแคลน/หายาก
definition: not easy to find or get because there is not enough of it
examples: Clean water is scarce after the storm. | As the weeks passed, fuel became increasingly scarce.
collocations: scarce resources | water is scarce | increasingly scarce

definition: a public statement that gives people information about something
examples: The principal made an announcement over the speakers. | Listen carefully: the announcement tells you where to go.
collocations: make an announcement | public announcement | official announcement

definition: to move people out of a dangerous place to somewhere safe
examples: Please evacuate the building now. | Hundreds of families were evacuated before the flood.
collocations: evacuate the building | forced to evacuate | emergency evacuation

thai: หลีกเลี่ยง
definition: to stay away from someone or something, or to stop something bad from happening
synonyms: keep away from | steer clear of | prevent
examples: Avoid the main stairs: they are blocked. | We took the back road to avoid the crowds.
collocations: avoid mistakes | try to avoid | avoid contact

thai: การทดลอง/การพิจารณาคดี
definition: a test of a new medicine, method or product to see if it works and is safe; also the process of judging a case in court
examples: The new drug is still in clinical trials. | Hundreds of students joined the trial without knowing the risks.
collocations: clinical trial | trial run | on trial

thai: ผลข้างเคียง
definition: an extra and usually unwanted result of a medicine or treatment
examples: The main side effect of this medicine is feeling sleepy. | Doctors must tell patients about every possible side effect.
collocations: common side effect | serious side effect | side effect of

definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm or danger
examples: The police officer stood at the gate to protect the students. | Wear a mask to protect yourself from infection.
collocations: protect from | protect the environment | well protected

definition: a quicker way of getting somewhere or of doing something
synonyms: quicker way | short way | easy way out
examples: There is no shortcut to learning a language. | We took a shortcut through the car park.
collocations: take a shortcut | no shortcut to | keyboard shortcut

thai: คล่องแคล่ว/พูดได้คล่อง
definition: able to speak or write a language easily and well
examples: LEXA promised students that they would be fluent by morning. | After two years abroad, she speaks fluent French.
collocations: fluent in English | speak fluently | fluent speaker

thai: ความพากเพียร
definition: the quality of continuing to try even when something is difficult
examples: Learning a language takes time and perseverance. | Her perseverance paid off when she finally passed the test.
collocations: hard work and perseverance | show perseverance | perseverance pays off
